verdict.rationale: Supabase is built on vanilla Postgres with read replicas, full-text search, and pgvector, but there is no evidence of any columnar/OLAP engine, materialized-view acceleration, or analytics-specific query optimization that would make heavy aggregations over large tables dashboard-fast without exporting to a warehouse. No mention of clickhouse-style analytics, columnar storage, or benchmarks for large-table aggregation performance.
